speaker: Sheldon
text: Dr. Gablehauser, I have a series of important multi- calculations and simulations to run. All she's doing is reducing irrelevant data and making a mo- Excuse me. Gablehauser. It's for you. Hello.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny, this is not a good time. No, I told you, you're not prepared for the sanctum of burning souls. You need to be in a group of at least five for that quest, and one should be a level thirty-five healer. Yeah, Penny, I can't log on and help you. We'll talk when I get home.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm not getting the computing time, am I?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, you have to do something about Penny. She's interfering with my sleep, she's interfering with my work, and if I had another significant aspect of my life, I'm sure she'd be interfering with that too.

speaker: Leonard
text: Dumbass. Why should I do something? You're the one who introduced her to online gaming.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, yes, but you're the one who said hello to her when she moved in. If you'd simply restrained yourself, none of this would be happening.

speaker: Leonard
text: Just tell her to leave you alone.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I did. I told her. I texted her. I sent out a very emphatic Twitter. I even changed my Facebook status to Sheldon Cooper wishes Penny would leave him alone. I don't know what else to do.

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, what am I supposed to do?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't know, but if you don't think you're something out, I warn you, I shall become very difficult to live with.

speaker: Leonard
text: You mean up until now we've been experiencing the happy fun time, Sheldon? I'll go talk to her.

speaker: Penny
text: No, Fritz, I need you on my flank. I don't know German. Flankensie, flankensie. I don't work on Mondays.

speaker: Leonard
text: Hey, Penny. Yeah, I see that. Shouldn't you be at work? It's Thursday.
